## 2. How to read this

Every beat and every block has one tag.

- Acting: they perform a moment, Akash directs it.
- Documentary: a real activity, and the camera just runs.
- Posed: controlled and still. Kept for the best light.
- Other: text cards, their own phone footage, found material.

## 5. The schedule

Package hours set the total. The clock starts when we arrive.

- Love Story + Film: 3 hours.
- The Signature Session: 5 hours, on one day or split across two days.
- The Pre Wedding: 10 hours across up to 2 days.

Every time below is a clock time. Every block has a tag. Their must-haves are shot early. Posed material waits for the best light.
